notes:
## New
- Coding ideas: one window with tabs for what to code for a feature, retrofit steps, cheat sheets and a search of every setting of your car.
- Simpler E-Sys MAX menu: tools are grouped, and tools that do not fit the car in E-Sys stay hidden.
- Right-click a module in the SVT > Edit settings: reads the module and opens every setting in the FDL-Editor.
- Ignition on / off from the PC on G-series cars.
- Ignition status next to the battery voltage shows how fresh it is.
- Open ICOM page: the ICOM's own page, or how to free a busy ICOM.
- Copy SVT and FA lines with a double-click or Ctrl+C, and Show in folder after saving.
- Car address box in Service functions and Service reset (remote sessions, ICOM or cable).
## Better
- Fault scan never opens a second connection next to E-Sys, and ignores an SVT that belongs to another car.
- Save names are filled in right the first time.
- E-Sys starts even when an antivirus removed E-Sys.exe.
- Works the same on PCs set to other languages.
- The launcher fits small screens better.
## Fixed
- SVT editor: select all then Delete no longer leaves modules behind.
- Battery status no longer stays on "reading" with some ICOMs.
- Many small fixes.
